    <rect id="c-proof" x="64" y="824" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• Recreate the selected infrastructure and release versions.<br>• Prove readiness, test-data setup and selected QA journeys.<br>• Exercise overlapping requests and failed/partial operations.<br>• Verify owned-resource cleanup and record any residue." fill="#ddddd8" stroke="#a8a8a0" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#434339" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690584670047" />
    <rect id="c-dependencies" x="1656" y="824" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• Reviewed infrastructure modules, inputs, state and identities.<br>• Artifact access, app deployment path and dependency setup.<br>• Schema/seed fixtures, secret references and test identities.<br>• Evidence storage, cost visibility and cleanup reconciliation." fill="#ddddd8" stroke="#a8a8a0" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#434339" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690584670048" />
    <rect id="c-controls" x="64" y="1200" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• Approved sizing, quotas, concurrency and allowed duration.<br>• Synthetic or explicitly approved sanitized test data.<br>• Per-instance ownership and scoped execution/cleanup.<br>• Expiry, extensions, evidence retention and failure support." fill="#ffe86d" stroke="#cbb333" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#574900" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690584670051" />
    <rect id="c-decisions" x="1656" y="1200" width="1432" height="224" data-content="• Shared infrastructure or dedicated project/cluster per need?<br>• Which dependencies are shared versus owned by each lab?<br>• Workflow/button or direct CLI, and who authorizes execution?<br>• Which profiles, tests, counts and lifecycle rules are required?" fill="#ffe86d" stroke="#cbb333" stroke-width="2" data-text-color="#574900" data-font-family="noto_sans" data-font-size="22" data-text-align="left" data-text-align-vertical="middle" data-miro-id="3458764690584670052" />
